purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and schema-first anonymous geometry review.
assessment: Official Maharashtra Land Records pages identify the Panvel survey office and city-survey property-card records. The linked public BhuNaksha viewer did not load through the web reader (redirect loop); no safe feature schema, point coverage, or polygon was verified. Official viewer could not be inspected past its redirect loop; no schema-safe geometry endpoint or feature was verified. No property-specific lookup or bypass was attempted.
registryAssessment: Maharashtra’s official Land Records Department lists the Panvel Sub-Superintendent of Land Records office and reports 15,386 property cards among Raigad city-survey records for Panvel. The state’s official BhuNaksha map interface is a parcel-map candidate, but its app redirected in a loop and no anonymous safe feature schema was verified. The city’s NAKSHA/drone survey references do not by themselves prove parcel-vector availability at the WUP point.
